title: 招聘顾问来电初筛 BA 合同岗
titleEn: A recruiter screens you for a BA contract role
scene: 周四上午，你接到一个陌生号码。对方是招聘中介（recruitment agency）的顾问 Brooke，在 LinkedIn 上看到你的资料，想推荐你去 CBD 一个州政府部门做 6 个月 BA 合同岗（可续约、混合办公）。 她语速很快，会一口气问：现在方不方便、你的工作权利、notice period、期望日薪（含不含 super）、Agile 经验，最后说要发 PD 给你、让你发更新的 CV。
你的目标：听懂合同时长和办公安排；说清 notice period 和日薪范围；没听清的地方至少追问 2 次；最后确认“谁、什么时候、发什么邮件”。

vocab.zh: 联系一下、简单沟通一下
vocab.ex: Just wanted to touch base about a role I'm working on.

vocab.zh: 简短聊几句（常指电话初筛）
vocab.ex: Have you got time for a quick chat?

vocab.zh: 合同岗（固定期限）；对比 permanent role 长期岗

vocab.ex: It's six months, with a view to extend.
It's hybrid, three days in and two from home.

vocab.zh: 离职需提前通知的时间
vocab.ex: My notice period is four weeks.
What sort of day rate are you after?

vocab.zh: 另加养老金 / 已含养老金
vocab.ex: Is that plus super or inclusive of super?
Just a ballpark figure is fine.

vocab.zh: 完全的工作权利（无限制）
vocab.ex: The role needs full working rights.
I'll put you forward to the hiring manager.

vocab.zh: 用人经理（真正做决定的人）
vocab.ex: The hiring manager wants to meet next week.

listening.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Brooke from Harbour Talent. Have I caught you at a bad time?
listening.sound: is that → “izzat”；caught you at → “cor-cha-at”，三个词连成一串；整句一口气说完。
listening.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Harbour Talent 的 Brooke。我是不是打扰你了？
listening.reply: No, it's fine. I've got a few minutes. / Actually, could I call you back in an hour?

listening.en: I came across your profile on LinkedIn and reckon you'd be a really good fit.
listening.sound: came across → “kay-muh-cross”；reckon you'd → “reck-uh-nyood”。reckon 是澳洲人最常用的“我觉得”。
listening.zh: 我在 LinkedIn 上看到你的资料，觉得你非常合适。
listening.reply: Oh, thanks. Can you tell me a bit more about the role?

listening.en: Six-month contract, view to extend, three days in, two from home.
listening.sound: 省掉了很多词：完整是 “It's a six-month contract, with a view to extend. You work three days in the office and two days from home.” 澳洲人常用这种“清单式”快说。
listening.zh: 6 个月合同，可续约，三天在办公室，两天在家。
listening.reply: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?

listening.en: What sort of day rate are you after? Just ballpark's fine.
listening.sound: what sort of → “wot-sorta”；are you after → “ah-ya-after”（after = 想要）；ballpark's = ballpark is。
listening.zh: 你期望多少日薪？说个大概就行。
listening.reply: I'd be looking for around seven fifty a day, plus super.

listening.en: No dramas, they're keen to get someone on board by early November.
listening.sound: No dramas = No worries（没问题）；get someone on board → “ge-someone-on-board”，t 几乎听不见；on board = 入职。
listening.zh: 没问题，他们希望 11 月初前有人入职。
listening.reply: Okay. My notice period is four weeks, so that should work.

listening.en: I'll flick you the PD this arvo. If you're keen, shoot me through an updated CV.
listening.sound: flick you / shoot me through = 发给你/发给我；PD = position description；arvo = afternoon；If you're keen → “if-yer-keen”。
listening.zh: 我今天下午把职位说明发给你。如果你感兴趣，就把更新的简历发给我。
listening.reply: Great. So you'll email me the PD this afternoon, and I'll send you my CV. Is that right?

speech.topic: 你是谁、现在做什么、一个最近的项目、你想找什么样的工作
paragraphs: Sure, happy to. My name is Amy, and I'm a Business Analyst based here in Adelaide. Over the last few years, I've mainly worked on projects that help teams replace manual processes with better systems and reporting.

In my current role, I work closely with business users and the IT team. A normal week for me includes running workshops, writing user stories, and making sure everyone agrees on the requirements before the developers start building.

One recent project I'm proud of is a reporting dashboard for our operations team. Before the project, they spent hours every week copying data into spreadsheets. I interviewed the key users, mapped the current process, and found out which numbers really mattered to them. Then I wrote the requirements and worked with the developers to test each part.

We had a few challenges. For example, at first we couldn't get access to test data, so I chased it up with the data team and we found a workaround. Now the team saves around five hours a week, and the managers can see the numbers straight away.

What I enjoy most about being a BA is turning a messy problem into something clear and practical. I'm good at asking questions, listening carefully, and writing things down so people can make decisions.

At the moment, I'm looking for a role where I can work with a wider range of stakeholders and keep growing my skills. I'm open to contract or permanent roles, and a hybrid set-up would suit me well. I can start after my notice period, which is four weeks.
speech.zh: 当然。我叫 Amy，是一名在阿德莱德工作的业务分析师。过去几年，我主要做的项目是帮助团队用更好的系统和报表替代手工流程。在现在的岗位上，我和业务用户、IT 团队紧密合作。我平常一周会主持工作坊、写用户故事，并确保开发开始之前大家对需求达成一致。最近一个让我自豪的项目，是给运营团队做的报表看板。项目之前，他们每周花好几个小时把数据复制到表格里。我访谈了关键用户，梳理了现有流程，弄清楚哪些数字对他们真正重要。然后我写了需求，并和开发一起测试每个部分。过程中有一些挑战。比如一开始我们拿不到测试数据的权限，我就去跟数据团队催，最后找到了变通办法。现在团队每周大约节省五个小时，经理们也能马上看到数据。做 BA 我最喜欢的，是把一个乱糟糟的问题变得清楚、可落地。我擅长提问、认真倾听，并把事情写清楚，方便大家做决定。目前我在找一个能接触更多不同利益相关方、继续提升能力的岗位。合同岗或长期岗我都可以考虑，混合办公会很适合我。我可以在离职通知期结束后入职，通知期是四周。

patterns.en: In my current role, I mainly work on ___, and I work closely with ___.
patterns.zh: 现在的岗位上，我主要做___，和___紧密合作。

patterns.en: One recent project I'm proud of is ___. Before that, ___. I ___, and now ___.
patterns.zh: 最近一个让我自豪的项目是___。之前___。我做了___，现在___。

patterns.en: What I enjoy most about ___ is ___. I'm good at ___.
patterns.zh: 关于___我最喜欢的是___。我擅长___。

patterns.en: At the moment, I'm looking for ___. I can start ___.
patterns.zh: 目前我在找___。我可以___入职。

lines.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Brooke calling from Harbour Talent. Have I caught you at a bad time?
lines.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Harbour Talent 的 Brooke。我是不是打扰你了？

lines.en: Hi Brooke. No, it's fine, I've got a few minutes. What's it about?
lines.zh: 你好 Brooke。没关系，我有几分钟。是什么事？

lines.en: Oh, lovely. So, I came across your profile on LinkedIn, and I reckon you'd be a really good fit for a BA role I'm working on at the moment. Just wanted to touch base and have a quick chat, if that's all right.
lines.zh: 哦，太好了。我在 LinkedIn 上看到你的资料，觉得你很适合我手上一个 BA 岗位。想跟你简单聊几句，可以吗？

lines.en: Sure, sounds good. Can you tell me a bit more about the role?
lines.zh: 好的。能多介绍一下这个岗位吗？

lines.en: Yeah, absolutely. So, it's with a state government department in the CBD. Six-month contract, view to extend, and it's hybrid, so three days in, two from home. They're replacing an old case management system, so there's a fair bit of stakeholder engagement, workshops, process mapping, that kind of thing.
lines.zh: 当然。是 CBD 的一个州政府部门。6 个月合同，可续约，混合办公，三天在办公室、两天在家。他们要替换一个老的案件管理系统，所以有不少和利益相关方沟通、工作坊、流程梳理之类的工作。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? I didn't quite catch the part after "six-month contract".
lines.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？“六个月合同”后面那部分我没太听清。

lines.en: Oh, sorry, I do talk fast! Six-month contract, with a view to extend, so there's a good chance it'll go longer. And it's hybrid: three days in the office, two at home.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉，我说话是挺快的！6 个月合同，有续约的可能，所以很可能会更长。混合办公：三天在办公室，两天在家。

lines.en: Got it, thanks. That sounds interesting. I've done a lot of workshops and process mapping in my current role.
lines.zh: 明白了，谢谢。听起来挺有意思。我现在的工作里做过很多工作坊和流程梳理。

lines.en: Perfect. And just quickly, it's government, so they need full working rights, and you'd have to pass a police check. Is that all okay for you?
lines.zh: 太好了。顺便问一下，因为是政府岗位，需要完全的工作权利，还要通过无犯罪记录审查。这些对你都没问题吧？

lines.en: Yes, I've got full working rights, and I'm happy to do a police check.
lines.zh: 没问题，我有完全的工作权利，也愿意做无犯罪记录审查。

lines.en: Great. And what's your notice period looking like?
lines.zh: 好。你的离职通知期是多久？

lines.en: It's four weeks.
lines.zh: 四周。

lines.en: Four weeks, no dramas. They're keen to get someone on board by early November, but I reckon they'd wait for the right person. Now, rates. What sort of day rate are you after? Just a ballpark's fine.
lines.zh: 四周，没问题。他们希望 11 月初前有人入职，不过我觉得遇到合适的人他们会愿意等。那说说薪资吧。你期望多少日薪？说个大概就行。

lines.en: Sorry, just to confirm, do you mean the daily rate for the contract?
lines.zh: 不好意思，确认一下，你是说这份合同的日薪吗？

lines.en: Yep, that's it. Contractors usually get paid by the day, so a dollar figure per day, and whether that's plus super or including super.
lines.zh: 对，就是这个。合同工一般按天付钱，所以就是每天多少钱，还有是另加 super 还是包含 super。

lines.en: Okay, thanks. I'd be looking for around seven hundred and fifty a day, plus super. But I'm a bit flexible, depending on the role.
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢。我期望每天大约 750 澳元，另加 super。不过根据岗位情况，我可以灵活一些。

lines.en: Yeah, that's right in the range they've got, so that works. Have you had much experience with Agile? Like, writing user stories, sitting in on sprint planning, that sort of thing?
lines.zh: 嗯，正好在他们的预算范围内，可以。你 Agile 经验多吗？比如写用户故事、参加冲刺计划会之类的？

lines.en: Yes, quite a lot. In my current team, I write the user stories and acceptance criteria, and I join sprint planning and the daily stand-ups.
lines.zh: 有，挺多的。在现在的团队里，我负责写用户故事和验收标准，也参加冲刺计划会和每日站会。

lines.en: Awesome. Okay, so here's what I'll do. I'll flick you the PD this arvo. Have a read, and if you're keen, shoot me through an updated CV, ideally tailored a bit to the role, and I'll put you forward to the hiring manager.
lines.zh: 太好了。那我这样安排：今天下午我把 PD 发给你。你看一下，如果感兴趣，就把更新过的简历发给我，最好针对这个岗位稍微调整一下，然后我把你推荐给用人经理。

lines.en: Sorry, what's a PD?
lines.zh: 不好意思，PD 是什么？

lines.en: Oh, sorry, position description. Basically the full job details: the duties, the skills they want, and who you'd report to.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉，就是职位说明。基本上是完整的岗位信息：职责、要求的技能，还有你向谁汇报。

lines.en: Ah, okay. So you'll email me the position description this afternoon, and then I'll send you my updated CV. Is that right?
lines.zh: 啊，好的。所以你今天下午把职位说明发邮件给我，然后我把更新的简历发给你，对吗？

lines.en: Spot on. If they like it, they'll probably want a quick Teams interview sometime next week. Would mornings or afternoons suit you better?
lines.zh: 完全正确。如果他们满意，可能下周会安排一个简短的 Teams 面试。上午还是下午对你更方便？

lines.en: Mornings are better for me, after nine thirty, because I do the school drop-off first. Could you send the interview details by email as well, please?
lines.zh: 上午对我更好，九点半以后，因为我要先送孩子上学。面试的具体信息也能发邮件给我吗？

lines.en: Yeah, of course, I'll pop everything in an email. Righto, thanks heaps for your time, Amy. Chat soon!
lines.zh: 当然，我会把所有信息都写在邮件里。好啦，非常感谢你抽时间，Amy。回头聊！

lines.en: Thanks, Brooke. Have a good day. Bye!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，Brooke。祝你今天愉快。再见！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower, please?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, what does PD stand for?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，PD 是什么的缩写？（换成任何听不懂的缩写）

rescue.en: Could you spell the name of your agency for me, please?
rescue.zh: 能帮我拼一下你们中介的名字吗？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, you mean three days in the office and two from home, right?
rescue.zh: 确认一下，你是说三天在办公室、两天在家，对吗？

rescue.en: Would you mind sending me the details by email, so I don't miss anything?
rescue.zh: 能把详细信息发邮件给我吗？这样我不会漏掉。

checklist: 我听懂了合同时长、办公安排和下一步安排
对话里我至少用了 2 次追问 / 确认句
我能用一句话说清 notice period 和期望日薪（含不含 super）
2 分钟演讲中间没有超过 5 秒的停顿
我用上了至少 3 个今天的新表达
